title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Genesis 9: God's covenant with Noah, the sign of the rainbow, and Noah's vineyard.

questions.text: What did God now give Noah and his sons as food?
questions.explanation: God said every moving thing that lives would be food for them; as he gave them the green herb, he gave them everything.

answers.text: Only the fish of the sea

questions.text: What did God say they must not eat?
questions.explanation: God said, "But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat."

questions.text: What reason does God give why the blood of whoever sheds man's blood will be shed?
questions.explanation: Whoever sheds man's blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

answers.text: God made man in his own image

questions.text: What did God promise in His covenant with Noah?
questions.explanation: God said all flesh would not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; there would never again be a flood to destroy the earth.

answers.text: The ground would always give good crops
Never again a flood to destroy the earth

questions.text: What did God set in the cloud as the sign of the covenant?
questions.explanation: God said, "I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth."

questions.text: What did Noah plant when he began to be a farmer?
questions.explanation: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

questions.text: Who saw the nakedness of his father and told his two brothers outside?
questions.explanation: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

questions.text: What did Shem and Japheth do?
questions.explanation: Shem and Japheth laid a garment on their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered their father without seeing his nakedness.

answers.text: Covered their father, walking in backwards
Left the tent and told everyone

questions.text: Whom did Noah curse when he awoke from his wine?
questions.explanation: Noah said, "Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers."

questions.text: How many years did Noah live in all?
questions.explanation: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood. All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
